News_Imges_Section.description: IQAC,NCC & NSS In association with District Administration, Chikkaballapur  jointly organised an awareness program “Walkathon – Say no to Plastic” Our past we cannot erase OUR FUTURE needs less waste on November 28, 2023 from Sidalaghatta Circle – Junior College – Town Hall Circle, Chikkaballapur. The “Walkathon – Say no to Plastic” was inaugurated by Sri. Ravindra .P.N, I.A.S, Deputy Commissioner and District Magistrate, Chikkaballapur.
